items.title: Pullback preserves short exact sequences whose quotient is flat

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pullback along a morphism of ringed topoi preserves a short exact sequence of modules whose third term is flat. The proof applies exactness of the inverse image to get a short exact sequence of modules over the pulled-back structure sheaf, uses that the pullback of a flat module is flat, and then invokes the vanishing of Tor over a flat module to conclude that tensoring the sequence with the structure sheaf of the source remains exact; since the pullback is by definition that tensor product, the conclusion follows (proof lines 7600-7611). H2: the reduction of exactness after pullback to exactness after tensoring over the pulled-back structure sheaf, using flatness, is the substance.
